description: One permanent slot per engine, from 7 upward (slot 7 is the first added engine; the OS numbers it machine 6).
Entries are appended, never reordered, never reused: a removed engine keeps its slot as a placeholder forever,
so a saved sound or pattern finds the same engine in any later build that includes it (ARCHITECTURE.md §4).
LiXR and SAM were dropped before launch, so they never took a shipped slot: the three offered engines sit at
7..9 with no gap. SAM keeps slot 10 reserved for when it is ready. The reference machine never gets a slot on the page.
